blocks.value: **Object-oriented programming is a programming methodology that defines objects whose behaviors and interactions accomplish a given task.**
Compare the two styles on the same problem, tracking a student.
**Procedural**, the way you have been writing:
Add a second student and you need a second set of variables, or parallel arrays you must keep in lockstep. Add an address and every method signature changes.
Each `Student` carries its own data **and** knows how to display itself. Adding a hundred students adds no complexity at all.
